programs.desc: A couple is finally ready to fulfil their dream of finding a family home in Apricale, Italy. They're looking for a historic property with character and a large kitchen, and he doesn't mind taking on a renovation, but she prefers something turnkey.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Sibling Rivalry in the DC Suburbs
programs.desc: A buyer has worked hard to get through a lot in life and is now ready to buy her first home outside Washington, DC. Her sisters have their own ideas about what's best for her in a purchase, and she'll have to struggle to make her own decision.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A first time buyer brings her friend along to search for a house in San Antonio; she wants a Craftsman style home that has character and plenty of space, but her friend, who is a homeowner herself, must keep her focused on what's important.

programs.title: Home Town Takeover
programs.desc: The Marrs hope to bring out the fun side of Fort Morgan, Colorado, by revamping the local bowling alley. Also, Ben and Erin are inspired by the area's unique geography to create a one-of-a-kind space to help draw in locals and visitors.

programs.title: Good Bones
programs.desc: A pair of first-time flippers is in over their heads renovating a historic Cottage Home property. They enlist Mina and Karen's help to navigate working with the local Historical Association and to prevent this new project from becoming a historic flop.

programs.title: Fix My Frankenhouse
programs.desc: Mike and Denese take on a family's home that's turned into a choppy maze of additions such as six staircases, seven types of flooring and three balconies.
